name: between-the-lines
description: Write comments from captured coding prompts and changed Python or Java code, with AST checks and local or custom inference.

between-the-lines.automatic.description: Analyze saved Python and Java changes after choosing a provider and task context. Annotations always require review.

between-the-lines.debounceMs.description: Wait after a save before analyzing, in milliseconds.

between-the-lines.maxSuggestions.description: Maximum manual suggestions per analysis. Each analysis makes at most twice this many model calls.

between-the-lines.inferenceThreads.description: CPU threads for local inference. Restart the worker with Unload Local Model after changing this.

between-the-lines.idleSeconds.description: Unload model memory after this many idle seconds.

between-the-lines.provider.description: Use the bundled CPU model or an explicitly configured custom chat-completions API. Configure Model Provider guides setup.

between-the-lines.endpoint.description: Full custom chat-completions endpoint URL. HTTPS is required except on loopback. Automatic comments send captured prompts and changed code here; manual analysis also sends selected context files.

between-the-lines.model.description: Model identifier accepted by the custom endpoint. Store API keys with Configure Model Provider, never in settings.

between-the-lines.automaticAnnotations.description: Use the selected model to write comments from captured prompts and verified Codex edits after each completed turn. Requires connected hooks and a prepared local model or configured custom endpoint.

between-the-lines.automaticCustomProvide.description: Allow automatic requests to the custom endpoint. Requires approval for this endpoint and model through Configure Model Provider on this installation.

between-the-lines.automaticCommentsPerFi.description: Maximum changed blocks to comment per file and agent turn. Each block uses generation and verification calls; raise this only if the extra local CPU time or API requests are acceptable.
